body:
## Purpose

Enhance accessibility for screen reader users by:
- ensuring decorative icons are not redundantly announced,
- providing meaningful labels for icon-only buttons,
- correcting the heading hierarchy for better semantic structure.

issue : [897](https://github.com/suitenumerique/docs/issues/897)

## Proposal

- [x] Added `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative icons to prevent screen readers from announcing them unnecessarily
- [x] Added `aria-label` on icon-only buttons (e.g., Home, Search) to describe their purpose
- [x] Extended the `Title` component to accept a `headingLevel` prop for semantic flexibility
- [x] Updated the homepage title to use a `<h1>` instead of `<h2>`, as it represents the main heading of the application
- [x] Added new i18n keys for `"Back to homepage"` and `"Search docs"` in all supported locales

body:
This commit introduces a new GitHub Actions workflow, `staging-ci.yml`, designed to keep the `Cargo.lock` file on the `staging` branch up-to-date automatically.

This workflow is triggered only after the `Test` workflow (from `build.yml`) completes successfully on the `staging` branch. It performs the following actions:
- Checks out your code.
- Runs `cargo update` to generate the most current `Cargo.lock` file.
- If the `Cargo.lock` file is modified, it commits the updated file back to the `staging` branch with a `[skip ci]` message to prevent CI loops.

This ensures that the `staging` branch always has a clean and up-to-date `Cargo.lock` file, which will prevent the `uncommitted changes` error from occurring in the release workflow.

body:
This PR addresses a schema and logic issue in the `processes_table` by swapping the column types of `response` and `mode`, and updating enum values accordingly.

According to the process specification:
- `response` should be of type `transmission_mode[]`(valid values: `value`, `reference`)
- `mode` should be of type `execution_mode[]` (valid values: `sync-execute`, `async-execute`, `dismiss`)

However, the current data has them reversed — `response` contains values like `SYNC`, `ASYNC`, and `mode` contains values like `VALUE`, which is incorrect.

Fixes in this PR:
- These changes are implemented through dedicated Flyway migration scripts.
    -  Swaps the data types of response and mode to their correct definitions
    -  Adds missing values to the execution_mode enum and transmission_mode enum
    -  Migrates existing data to match the correct formats
    - Updates transmission_mode values in processes_table to lowercase (value, reference).
- Updates logic in `ProcessesRunnerImpl` to use the corrected `mode` column for determining async/sync execution
